name: FAQ Panel
description: A structured question-and-answer surface for accordion, sidebar, and grid FAQ layouts.

accessibility.semantics: Use native semantic elements in templates before ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Interactive descendants must be reachable by keyboard and expose visible focus.
notes: Color is never the only communication channel.
Motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion where animation exists.

responsive.strategy: Intrinsic layout with logical properties, responsive grids, and container queries where useful.

examples.name: Default
examples.notes: Adapted from old-components into tokenized SiteKit styling.
